title: Cow holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d='M50 36 C44 28 32 29 32 39 C32 47 42 54 50 61 C58 54 68 47 68 39 C68 29 56 28 50 36 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d='M50 36 C47 32 42 31 39 34' stroke='#ffb3c1' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='24' ry='13' fill='#f4f4f4'/>

  <rect x='61' y='90' width='5' height='8' rx='2' fill='#e6e6e6'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='33' y='95' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6b4527'/>
  <rect x='60' y='95' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6b4527'/>

  <path d='M67 78 C72 70 68 62 60 58' stroke='#e6e6e6' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <circle cx='41' cy='58' r='4' fill='#6b4527'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='58' r='4' fill='#6b4527'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='17' ry='14' fill='#f4f4f4'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='45' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f4f4f4' transform='rotate(-20 33 45)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='45' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f4f4f4' transform='rotate(20 67 45)'/>
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='45' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ffb3c1' transform='rotate(-20 33 45)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='45' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ffb3c1' transform='rotate(20 67 45)'/>

  <path d='M58 39 Q60 33 55 33' stroke='#e0c070' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8a5a3b'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='50' r='3' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='50' r='3' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='49' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='49' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#ffb3c1'/>

  <ellipse cx='47' cy='56' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#d96a85'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='56' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#d96a85'/>
